about_short_description.short_description: Pikamoon is an Ethereum blockchain game,For gamers of all ages, Pikamoon's metaverse gameplay is fun and gratifying.

product.name: Battle Royale Mode
product.description: A multiplayer game mode set in 'The Nexus,' a battleground at the intersection of six elemental regions where players compete to survive.

product.name: Open World Mode
product.description: An expansive open world where players explore, tame creatures called Pikamoons, and compete to control six elemental regions.

product.name: Pikamoon NFTs
product.description: Non-fungible tokens representing creatures and assets used for combat, survival, and play-to-earn activities within the Pikamoon game world.

product.name: Planet Dreva
product.description: A vast open-world environment offering exploration, adventures, and various gameplay experiences within the Pikamoon metaverse.

product.name: PIKA Arcade Mini Games
product.description: A collection of casual mini games within the Pikamoon ecosystem offering gameplay experiences beyond combat and survival.
